title: Burnham under fire over influencers’ No 10 reception after TikTok video row
summary_full: Tories accuse PM of ‘degrading’ Downing Street as Max Balegde takes down clip of himself miming explicit lyricsAndy Burnham is facing a backlash for inviting social media influencers to Downing Street after one of a group attending an event posted a clip of himself miming to a viral song with explicit lyrics outside No 10.Downing Street said it was right that Max Balegde had taken down a TikTok post of him mouthing the words “bomboclaat pussywagon chicken nuggets” after attending an event at the prime minister’s residence.
